## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feat/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…`, or `chore/…` and rebased on `main`
- [ ] Pull request title is a conventional commit, such as `fix: tooltip position on scroll`
- [ ] Added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` (mark **Breaking** if existing copies break)
- [ ] `bun run check` and `bun run test` pass
- [ ] Reduced motion, keyboard, and 44px tap targets checked
- [ ] For a new component, registry entry and dates added in `lib/registry.ts` and `lib/component-dates.ts`
